en.title: Vanuatu ferry disaster: 1 dead, over 30 missing after ferry sinks in bad weather
en.summary: The MV Matui ferry sank off Vanuatu in adverse weather conditions, leaving one person dead and more than 30 missing, though 15 survivors were rescued. Authorities are examining potential contributing factors including weather and possible overloading.

stories.title: ‎Saudi merchandise imports down 5% to SAR 224.5B in Q2 2026

en.title: Saudi merchandise imports down 5% to SAR 224.5B in Q2 2026
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's merchandise imports decreased 5% year-on-year to SAR 224.5 billion in the second quarter of 2026. Machinery and electrical equipment represented nearly 30% of total imports, followed by transport equipment at 10%.

stories.title: ‎Saudi Arabia posts SAR 61.5B trade surplus in Q2 2026

en.title: Saudi Arabia posts SAR 61.5B trade surplus in Q2 2026
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's trade surplus reached SAR 61.5 billion in Q2 2026, up 62% year-on-year, driven by a 4% increase in total exports to SAR 285.98 billion and a 5% decline in imports to SAR 224.46 billion. Oil exports rose 9% while non-oil exports fell 7%.

en.title: TASI: 5 stocks, 2 REITS fall to 52-week lows
en.summary: Five stocks listed on the TASI index and two real estate investment fund units reached their lowest prices in 52 weeks on September 13, with declines ranging from 13% to 50% over the period.

en.title: TASI: 6 stocks, 4 REITs fall to all-time lows
en.summary: Six stocks and four real estate investment fund units traded on the TASI index fell to their lowest prices since their initial listings on September 13, with year-to-date declines ranging from 9% to 53%.

stories.title: ‎IA: Driver coverage varies by vehicle insurance policy type

en.title: IA: Driver coverage varies by vehicle insurance policy type
en.summary: The Insurance Authority clarified that driver coverage under vehicle insurance policies depends on the policy type, distinguishing between third-party liability and damage coverage. Comprehensive insurance for private vehicles covers the policyholder, certain family members, and sponsored or employed drivers.
